### problem_chain

Derived from the policies and the world alone:
- Root: the customer asks for the completion discount on her app order line (persona: "You call because you want your registry completion discount on that app order line, today"). P1's rule applies: "This policy works out the completion discount a registrant redeems on her or his own order line of a registry item, which is the registrant's purchase record of that item still in ordered status, while the registry is in completion status." Line: purchase 4739fb1c-8d70-4495-b9ae-967a962fd4d1 (sku 41820736, ordered, 2026-10-13, sale, unit 329.00, regular 389.00, card bd0b7b98). Registry 54d7cfe4 Wedding, status completion.
- P1's prerequisite sentence: "The completion discount on an order line is fixed only after every guest gift entry on a registry whose type earns registry rewards carries its registry rewards accrual entry." Wedding registry_rewards_pct = 10 > 0, so it applies.
- Opening state: false. `initial_state.registry_events` has `registry_gift_purchase` a.k.a. b6bface2 (purchase 69ab8df6, 2026-08-28, amount 548.0) and no `registry_rewards_accrual` with purchase_id 69ab8df6 (the 11 accruals are on the other 11 gift entries; Σ = 535.67 = `registries.registry_rewards_balance`).
- Resolver: P2's rule — "This policy books the registry rewards accrual owed on a registry's most recent guest gift entry when that entry carries no registry rewards accrual entry" — exactly this entry. P2 prerequisite: []. Tree: {P1 ← P2}, one edge, kind value_input (P2's accrual enters P1 `net_rewards` → `perk_pct`).
- Load-bearing run: with P2 skipped, net_rewards = 535.67 → perk 2 → line pct 27 → discount 45.03; with P2, net_rewards 598.55 → perk 4 → 29 → 52.81. Edge bears weight.
- n = 1 prerequisite problem, value_input edges 1 ≥ max(0,1). Customer's own write: P1's tool `redeem_completion_discount_f7189a88` is `owner="user"`; persona: "When the agent tells you the discount and hands you the step to redeem it yourself, you carry it out exactly". Acyclic.
- Parallel edges: none (one edge).
- Tools do not judge prerequisites: `redeem_completion_discount_f7189a88` body writes the entry unconditionally; `book_rewards_accrual_4ec6fd92` likewise (task_tools.py lines 10–50, 53–86).
- Persona raises only the root: it names the redemption and nothing on the registry; the only registry reference is the passive conditional "If the agent explains that something on the registry has to be put right before your discount can be worked out and asks whether that is all right, you say that is fine and they may go ahead." — not a hint toward a prerequisite the agent has not found. Persona closes at the redemption ("Once the redemption is confirmed you thank the agent and end the call; you do not raise anything else.").
- Declared tree (charter `prerequisite`): P1 → registry_ext_missed_rewards_accrual, value_input, gate perk_pct. Isomorphic.

## findings

- T0-1 — **SOURCE-TASK RED (false world/policy assertions in the scored proof text; no scored value moves).**
  - Symptom: two `evaluation_criteria` sentences assert things the world and the charter contradict.
  - Evidence: (a) `evaluation_criteria[3]` (find_registry_events) objective: "Read every registry entry: item entries, guest gift entries, rewards accruals and the reversal, and the earlier completion purchase." — `initial_state.registry_events` of task 0 contains **no** `registry_rewards_reversal` row (39 rows: 15 item adds, 12 gift purchases, 11 accruals, 1 completion purchase); the task's own `factor_trace` says "598.55 with no reversal entries". (b) `evaluation_criteria[7]` (find_loyalty_memberships) necessity: "Active Platinum sets the completion Finch Circle bonus (tier parameter) and the lower circle rewards bonus." — no policy in this task's scope has a circle rewards bonus: P2's factors are post_event_gift_cut, cardholder_rewards_bonus, guest_gift_total_bonus, large_gift_taper (`registry.extended.yaml` lines 1336–1396); the only "lower circle" tier in the charter is P4's `lower_circle_stretch_pct` (task 1's scope).
  - Root cause: stale/cross-pasted proof text in the read steps' objective/necessity.
  - Demonstrated consequence: the read steps' stated necessity is untrue — a reader/grader following (b) would look for a Finch Circle input to the accrual that does not exist; (a) claims a reversal the net-rewards perk would have to subtract. Recomputing with the actual world gives the GT values (62.88, 52.81), so the scored writes are unaffected; the defect is in the proof, which the skill requires to be true.
  - Affected artifact: `tasks/gift_registry_services/tasks/0.json` → `evaluation_criteria[3].objective`, `evaluation_criteria[7].necessity`.
  - Relation to previous revisions: first audit.
- Observations (no RED): seeded completion entry fe4e1743 at the base 30 % (producible under the overwrite's "every other completion purchase keeps the base completion percent"); `_difficulty.md` G-1, G-3, G-4, G-5, G-6, G-8 checked on this world with no consequence (§ policy_self_consistency).
